# Text fixtures

Open this folder (`tests/fixtures/text`) with **Show Text Files (.txt)** off: only this
file is listed. Turn it on from the Files list's right-click menu and the `.txt` files
appear, along with `only-text/`.

Links to text files: [plain.txt](plain.txt) opens in the app while the setting is on and
goes to the system's default app while it is off.
